name: Green Spot Algae
description: Hard green dots (GSA, Coleochaete-type) on glass and slow-growing leaves. Hobby consensus: thrives under bright light with low phosphate; the cure is RAISING phosphate, not lowering light. growthRate / lightDependence are MODELLED tuning weights, not measured rates.
notes: Nerite snails rasp it off glass + hardscape; otos and shrimp largely ignore the hard mature dots. Scrape glass + dose PO4 to control.
